sources.title: Cloudflare Docs
sources.snippet: ## Freshness (TTL) Freshness, also known as Time to Live (TTL), determines how long a cache can use an object without checking with the origin again. For example, if an object has a TTL of five minutes, the cache serves it directly for five minutes after first receiving it.
